title: Asparagus and White Wrap
description: A simple yet flavorful Ukrainian-inspired dish featuring asparagus and white wrap.
instructions: 1. Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
2. Add olive oil if using, then add asparagus and cook for 3-4 minutes.
3. Flip asparagus and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes or until tender.
4. Meanwhile, warm the white wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
5. Assemble the wrap by placing asparagus in the center.
7. Fold the wrap to enclose the filling.
